subcategory_text: Stakeholder privacy preferences are included in algorithmic design objectives and outputs are evaluated against these preferences.
informative_references: Aligned with NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.11 (bias evaluated)
implementation_examples: Include stakeholder privacy preferences as objectives in the design of algorithmic systems, and evaluate the produced outputs against those preferences
Document the preferences and their weighting, and the evaluation method
Re-examine when preferences, populations, or use contexts change
assessment_objectives: Determine whether stakeholder privacy preferences are documented as design objectives
Determine whether algorithmic outputs are evaluated against the preferences
Determine whether the evaluation is repeated when preferences, data, or context change
Determine whether results feed into model governance
